messages:
rhea (design): quick drop 1: compact sweep layout for prompt-set evals. tiny rows, inline failure snippet, and a floating action rail when multiple selected. prototype: https://figma.com/compact-sweep
omar (pm): aim: let reviewers clear obvious false positives quickly while keeping auditability. require modal if >9 items.
dev (frontend): plan: show count badge, add an accessible live announcer when selection changes, lazy load expanded snippets. question: should primary action read "Approve tests" or "Mark approved"?
rhea (design): prefer "Approve tests" to match event names. show visible count separate from CTA to avoid VoiceOver quirks.
samir (a11y): accessibility notes: 1) don't rely on color alone for regression heat; include icon+label. 2) use a dedicated aria-live region that updates on selection like "3 tests selected". 3) ensure keyboard reveals the rail and actions are in logical tab order.
dev (frontend): implementation detail: inserting the rail node sometimes doesn't trigger VO announcements; i'll also update a hidden `div#select-announce[aria-live="polite"]` programmatically.
omar (pm): microcopy: confirmation modal title = "Approve tests"; body = "This will mark N tests as approved in this prompt set. You can undo within 10 seconds." primary = "Approve tests" (danger), secondary = "Cancel". toast = "N tests approved 1 Undo".
rhea (design): UX tweak: use fade mask for snippet truncation instead of line-clamp (fixes mid-word clipping on iOS). no per-row expansion by default; offer a small "more" control that reveals inline details.
samir (a11y): ensure the "more" control has aria-expanded and the expanded region has role=region and an accessible name. also avoid parentheses in visible labels.
staging-bot: preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/evals/compact-sweep (build 8460) 
rhea (design): checklist for reviewers: - keyboard focus visible - selection announcer reads counts - primary CTA reads "Approve tests" - fade mask applied - undo toast focusable
omar (pm): ping here with 1-line verifications please. aiming for merge after a11y sign-off.
